subject: Scheduling: Kickoff to size inference pool for NovusAI
messages:
From: Sam Morgan <sam@novusai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap - NovusAI inference needs

Irene, thanks again for the chat earlier. Short recap from our side:
- We run a multi-tenant inference tier for our customer-facing agent (1.2M monthly active users).
- Typical prompt length 120 tokens, occasional long-form 1k tokens for document summarization.
- Peak concurrent requests ~1,200, sustained spikes to ~2,500 for flash events.
- Target avg token latency ~250ms; tail P95 < 750ms.
- Budget considerations: want to evaluate tradeoffs between fewer larger GPUs vs more smaller instances.

We'd like to move to a technical sizing session with someone from your infra team to validate assumptions and get a ballpark committed pool. Availability next week: Mon 9/13 morning PST or Thu 9/16 afternoon PST.

Also looping in Priya (infra lead) - she prefers calendar invites.

Thanks,
Sam Morgan
Head of Platform Engineering, NovusAI

---
